# TemporalKernel

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
The mapping from input time series to reservoir state trajectories that serves as a nonlinear temporal feature extractor. Determines the types of temporal patterns that can be distinguished, directly impacting iNEST's ability to process time-varying signals in-network.
